clips.asr_text: Today's topic is The Open Window.
開いた窓
急用のため田舎を訪れた男性が、初対面の人たちと過ごす短い物語です。 静かな訪問先での会話が、彼の気持ちをどう変えていくのかに耳を傾けてください。
庭に面した開いた窓について、少女がどんな話をするのかに注目してください。
少女は、叔母の夫と弟たちが3年前に狩りに出たまま戻らなかったと話しました。叔母が戻った後、開いた窓を巡って何が起きるのでしょうか。
少女が戻ってきたというと、フラムトンは不安を感じながら、窓の外を振り返りました。窓の外には誰が現れたのでしょうか。
Letter of Introduction
紹介状
Open onto
何々に面して開いている。
Marsh
沼地

Framton Nuttel felt nervous. Even in this quiet sitting room, he kept turning his letter of introduction between his fingers. His doctor wanted him resting quietly in the country, not visiting strangers.
My aunt will come downstairs in a minute.
said the fifteen-year-old sitting opposite him.
How well do you know her?
I don't really know anything about her.
The girl's eyes turned towards the French window, open onto the lawn.
Doesn't that open window seem strange at this time in October?
Well, the weather's still quite warm.
Crampton answered.
Her husband and two young brothers went shooting three years ago today. They went outside through that very window.
For a moment she stopped speaking, and Frampton waited.
They never came back from the marsh, where the ground seemed firm; all three sank into deep mud with their little brown spaniel; nobody ever found their bodies.
Frampton's fingers stopped turning the letter.

She expects them back and leaves it open until dark. Her husband wore a white waterproof coat over his shoulders. Her youngest brother sang, Oh brother, why are you jumping? He always sang that to annoy her.
The girl swallowed hard.
When it starts getting dark, and sometimes almost feel they really will.
Then someone opened the door. His host rushed in, saying how sorry she was.
I hope you've enjoyed talking to my niece. Is the open window all right with you? My husband and brothers will soon return from shooting. They'll get my carpets so dirty.

Frampton tried to find a safe subject and explained his doctor's orders. He needed complete rest without any excitement. She listened, but kept looking past him, towards the lawn. Suddenly, she looked happy.
They're finally back!
The girl watched the window with her mouth slightly open. Framton turned, feeling cold inside.
Three men with guns were crossing the lawn as darkness came. One wore a white coat over his shoulders, and a tired brown spaniel followed them. A young man's voice called in the evening light.
Oh, brother, why are you jumping?
Frampton took his hat and stick and ran through the hall. He rushed out of the gate, forcing a passing cyclist into the hedge. The men entered through the open window.
Who's the man who just ran away?
The husband asked as he cleaned his muddy boots.
Such a strange visitor.
She replied.
He looked like he'd seen a ghost.
The Spanish frightened him.
the girl said calmly.
He told me he was terribly afraid of dogs. Once, a pack chased him into a cemetery. He spent the night in an empty grave, with the dogs looking down at him.
She looked over at the sleepy dog.
He told me they took turns.
